about_the_game:
PUSH BEYOND THE LIMITS AND CLIMB THE CHAMPIONSHIPS

Playing the CAREER mode of The Racing Journey, you can forge your destiny in motorsport starting from scratch.

Start with a simple rental kart at local tracks, challenging local champions. If you’re skilled enough and manage your budget wisely, you’ll move on to better karts and eventually step into cars.

But in single-seaters, the challenge becomes tougher than ever! You’ll start to make a name for yourself in lower series like the Drive 4™ National Championship, before moving on to where the true champions race: the WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

Defeat the competition in Drive 3™, Drive 2™, and reach the true peak of motorsport: the Drive 1™ World Championship.

MANAGE YOUR FINANCES

Motorsport isn’t all sunshine and glory, especially if you’re not rich!

No championship will let you race for free, and you’ll need to carefully manage your income and expenses, or risk being left on the sidelines.

But don’t worry: if you’re fast enough on track, SPONSORS will soon come knocking, and you might even be backed by a Drive 1™ DRIVER ACADEMY throughout your career.

MANAGE YOUR STAFF

To go fast on track, you need a strong STAFF behind you.

A great RACE ENGINEER can drastically improve both your performance and your vehicle, giving you the right feedback during races and analyzing your laps before and after sessions.

Having a good MANAGER is also crucial, as they’ll help you secure better contracts with sponsors.

KEEP YOUR VEHICLE IN SHAPE

You don’t want reliability issues in the middle of a race, do you? That’s why it’s important to TUNE your vehicle and check it regularly, replacing worn-out parts and even adding UPGRADES.

AND BE CREATIVE!

Unleash your creativity and CUSTOMIZE your car’s livery however you like. Change colors, pick your favorite patterns, and don’t forget to stick your sponsors’ logos!

And take care of your GARAGE too! You can buy decorations that are not only stylish but also useful. After all, why not buy a nice TV to replay your best overtakes?

name: The Racing Journey

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or Intel Core i3-10100F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-12400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 3060 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: The Racing Journey is a realistic racing videogame where you can experience the entire career of a professional racing driver. Start racing in local championships with simple rental karts, and defeat your rivals until you reach Drive 1™!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
*languages with full audio support
